quotes.name: Reconstruction
quotes.flavor: Tedious research made the Sages of the College of Lat-Nam adept in repairing broken artifacts.

quotes.name: Enlightened Tutor
quotes.flavor:
"Organization is often undervalued but rarely unjustified."
—Frasio, royal archivist

quotes.name: Throw from the Saddle
quotes.flavor:
"A little kindness would've carried you a lot farther than those spurs."
—Miriam, herd whisperer

quotes.name: Feral Krushok
quotes.flavor: In a stunning act of diplomacy, Yasova Dragonclaw ceded a portion of Temur lands to the Sultai. Her clan protested until they saw she had given the Sultai the breeding grounds of the krushoks. They hadn't realized she had a sense of humor.

quotes.name: Mahadi, Emporium Master
quotes.set_name: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate
quotes.flavor: "Welcome to the Wandering Emporium. Feel free to browse the bazaar. We have everything a lost soul could want, need, or afford."

quotes.name: Invasion of Theros // Ephara, Ever-Sheltering
quotes.flavor: When the sun falters and the seas disperse, when the wilds wither and the forges go cold, when death itself succumbs, she endures.

quotes.name: Kederekt Parasite
quotes.flavor: When the smell of passing thoughts piques its hunger, its maw becomes primed with acid and a taste for brains.

quotes.name: Back in Town
quotes.flavor:
"Well, there's a good day's work ruined."
—Erin Nath, Omenport gravedigger

quotes.name: Experimental Frenzy
quotes.flavor: Turns out coffee is the weird aunt of invention.

quotes.name: Phyrexian Processor
quotes.flavor: An assembly line of inhumanity.

quotes.name: Myr Reservoir
quotes.flavor: A mana well as bottomless as the myr are tireless.

quotes.name: Thornwood Falls
quotes.flavor: Deep in Eldraine's wilds, strange eyelike appendages twined among the vines and faerie lights.

quotes.name: Abolish
quotes.flavor: As war raged on, the young mages became more direct in their tactics, often at great cost.

quotes.name: Destroy Evil
quotes.flavor:
"You're not the first two-bit tyrant I've punched in the face."
—Captain America, Steve Rogers

quotes.name: Timberpack Wolf
quotes.flavor: Their strength is no mere numbers game. An intangible force augments the wolves when they run together.

quotes.name: Disciple of Bolas
quotes.flavor: "Lord Bolas has shown me how each miserable little life holds untold resources."

quotes.name: Geier Reach Bandit // Vildin-Pack Alpha
quotes.flavor: The cathars realized they had not tracked her—she had led them here.

quotes.name: Gravity Well
quotes.flavor: Storms spread throughout Oran-Rief, ripping the skies with wind and rain. Airborne creatures sought shelter where they could.

quotes.name: Trouble in Pairs
quotes.flavor: Together, they're greater than the sum of their rap sheets.

quotes.name: Forge Devil
quotes.flavor: Devils infiltrated the lower levels of Thraben Cathedral, making cracks in load-bearing pillars and setting fire to precious archives.

quotes.name: Kami of Old Stone
quotes.flavor:
"There was a wall here. Now it is dust. A tower rose here. Now it is fallen. An army fought here. Now it is dead. A spirit was here. It is all that remains."
—Snow-Fur, kitsune poet

quotes.name: War Room
quotes.flavor: A figure is moved on a map, and the tide of war changes.

quotes.name: Lightning Elemental
quotes.flavor: A lightning elemental once killed an entire tribe of merfolk—simply by going for a swim.

quotes.name: Daring Leap
quotes.flavor: Most warriors think in only two dimensions. Agnate and his metathran brethren were trained to battle in three.

quotes.name: Reprocess
quotes.flavor: The battle's end is the meal's beginning.

quotes.name: Brushland
quotes.flavor:
"Urza fortified every thirty miles on the path to Tomakul, creating a network of trenches the brothers would trade for decades."
—*The Antiquities War*

quotes.name: Bond of Agony
quotes.flavor: The Rakdos are unique in designing torture equipment they can operate while "suffering" alongside their victims.

quotes.name: Ivy Lane Denizen
quotes.flavor: "Skyknight gear? Well, I have drake-skin gauntlets, supple and fireproof. Or a ceratok chestplate that'll stop a crossbow bolt."

quotes.name: Ripples of Potential
quotes.flavor: Nightkin are but a whisper on the wind, up until there is blood on the grass.

quotes.name: Trapped in the Tower
quotes.flavor: "At least up here I have some peace and quiet."

quotes.name: Mind Spring
quotes.flavor: Fragments of thought refract and multiply, surging in a geyser of dizzying insight.

quotes.name: One with the Machine
quotes.flavor:
"When I grafted the Planar Bridge into myself, I felt my Planeswalker spark flare beyond my body. The Multiverse was my plaything. It felt . . . incredible."
—Tezzeret

quotes.name: Surgical Extraction
quotes.flavor: Dead Horse Delivers Beating

quotes.name: Gloom Sower
quotes.flavor:
"First, the darkness fell. Terror came next. After that, only despair remained."
—*The Tragedy of Morein*

quotes.name: Goblin Haberdasher
quotes.flavor: An accessory in every sense of the word.

quotes.name: Lightning Rift
quotes.flavor: Options will cost you, but a lack of them will cost you even more.

quotes.name: Goblin Instigator
quotes.flavor: "We can take 'em. You go first!"

quotes.name: Sram's Expertise
quotes.flavor: "It's important to always have the right tool for the job. This one is for picking my teeth."

quotes.name: Stampeding Wildebeests
quotes.set_name: Duel Decks Anthology: Garruk vs. Liliana
quotes.flavor: The most violent and destructive storms in Femeref occur on cloudless days.

quotes.name: Ritual of Restoration
quotes.flavor: Leonin raising ceremonies take place at the white sun's dawn, the rebirth of artifacts mirroring the birth of a new day.

quotes.name: Electropotence
quotes.flavor: Where life and force collide.

quotes.name: Sigiled Starfish
quotes.flavor: Kruphix hid the most dire prophecies about humankind where humans would never find them and tritons wouldn't care to read them.

quotes.name: Wasteland
quotes.flavor:
"But I am going to Mordor," said Frodo.
"I know that well enough," said Sam. "Of course you are. And I'm coming with you."

quotes.name: Razaketh, the Foulblooded
quotes.flavor: Liliana insisted on coming to Amonkhet to confront one of the two remaining demons to whom she is bound.

quotes.name: Phoenix Heart
quotes.flavor:
"The minute I heard my first love story,
I started looking for you, not knowing
how blind that was.
Lovers don't finally meet somewhere.
They're in each other all along."
—Rumi

quotes.name: Avenger of Zendikar
quotes.flavor: Vengeance is a brew best served chilled.

quotes.name: Stiltzkin, Moogle Merchant
quotes.flavor: "How about a three-piece combo of Hi-Potion, Ether, and Phoenix Pinion for 444 Gil?"

quotes.name: Growth Spiral
quotes.flavor:
"The Blind Eternities have taken everything from my family. I will not serve them."
—Jamira, Strixhaven first-year

quotes.name: Indrik Stomphowler
quotes.flavor:
"An indrik's howl has destructive power much subtler than that of its crushing foot. The sound is mundane, but inaudible vibrations scatter and sunder magical contrivances."
—Simic research notes

quotes.name: Bone to Ash
quotes.flavor:
"I can think of worse ways to go. On second thought, maybe not."
—Ludevic, necro-alchemist

quotes.name: Thunderfoot Baloth
quotes.flavor: If you hear it, it's too late.

quotes.name: Deathmark
quotes.flavor:
"Let the final vision of doom be etched upon their unblinking eyes."
—Zul Ashur, lich lord

quotes.name: Gather the White Lotus
quotes.flavor: "I see you favor the white lotus gambit. Not many still cling to the ancient ways."

quotes.name: Tainted Monkey
quotes.flavor: "C'mon, choose 'monkey.' Everybody loves monkeys!"

quotes.name: Venomized Cat
quotes.flavor: New York City's rat problem disappeared overnight.

quotes.name: Woodland Cemetery
quotes.flavor:
"They never found the body of young Josu, or that of his murderous sister."
—"The Fall of the House of Vess"

quotes.name: Invasion of Ikoria // Zilortha, Apex of Ikoria
quotes.flavor: Phyrexia's largest goliaths stormed Ikoria, ready to challenge the world's great monsters. Zilortha was unimpressed.

quotes.name: King's Assassin
quotes.flavor: Fear is as effective a weapon as the blade.

quotes.name: Nightmare
quotes.flavor: The thunder of its hooves beats dreams into despair.

quotes.name: Sunmane Pegasus
quotes.flavor: Chosen by Heliod, Daxos approached the pegasus without fear, and rode it without saddle or reins.

quotes.name: Coppercoat Vanguard
quotes.set_name: March of the Machine: The Aftermath
quotes.flavor: It was a time for rebuilding, but first Ikoria's wrecked cities had to be cleared of monsters.

quotes.name: Smuggler's Copter
quotes.flavor: Don't forget to thank the Bus Driver.

quotes.name: Supreme Verdict
quotes.flavor: Leonos had no second thoughts about the abolishment edict. He'd left skyrunes warning of the eviction, even though it was cloudy.

quotes.name: Invigorating Surge
quotes.flavor: For hydras, most problems can be solved with the addition of a few extra heads.

quotes.name: Woolly Loxodon
quotes.flavor: Even among the hardiest warriors of the Temur, loxodons are respected for their adaptation to the mountain snows.

quotes.name: Not on My Watch
quotes.flavor: "You know, Proft, I've done a lot of questionable things in my life, but helping a pompous detective save lives is a new low, even for me."

quotes.name: Seraph of Dawn
quotes.flavor: She parts the clouds so sunlight can reach even the darkest lairs and duskiest tombs.

quotes.name: Frost Marsh
quotes.flavor:
"Now caged in Winter's bitter chill,
Our people cry, their voices shrill—
Eternal cold breaks down their will."
—*The Dynasty of Winter Kings*

quotes.name: Nissa's Renewal
quotes.flavor: Her connection to the plane restored, Nissa felt the power of Zendikar surge through her.

quotes.name: Ichor Shade
quotes.flavor: As oil seeped into their funeral shrouds, Tolvada's dead rose to join the invaders' ranks.

quotes.name: Amrou Scout
quotes.flavor: The people of Amrou were scattered by war and driven into hiding. Scouts maintain the beacon fires that signal "return" and "home."

quotes.name: Kolodin, Triumph Caster
quotes.flavor: "Stay in formation! We win this together, or not at all."

quotes.name: Etali, Primal Storm
quotes.flavor: The storm rages and the earth breaks.

quotes.name: Micromancer
quotes.flavor: "Ideas don't have to be big to be great."

quotes.name: Dancing Scimitar
quotes.flavor: Bobbing merrily from opponent to opponent, the scimitar began adding playful little flourishes to its strokes; it even turned a couple of somersaults.

quotes.name: High Market
quotes.flavor: If it can't be had here, it can't be had on any world.

quotes.name: Manifold Key
quotes.flavor:
"Locks want to be opened, and treasure wants to be free."
—Nayrex Slipfinger, master thief

quotes.name: Bootleggers' Stash
quotes.flavor: Labyrinths of tunnels beneath the streets of the Caldaia offer an ample array of discreet routes for enterprising smugglers.

quotes.name: Crisis of Conscience
quotes.flavor: "Just touch these two strands together and the Daleks are finished. Have I that right?"

quotes.name: Forgotten Ancient
quotes.flavor: Its blood is life. Its body is growth.

quotes.name: Hullbreacher
quotes.flavor: "I don't need a map to find riches."

quotes.name: Geier Reach Sanitarium
quotes.flavor: All are welcome.

quotes.name: Rakdos Signet
quotes.flavor: Made of bone and boiled in blood, a Rakdos signet is not considered finished until it has been used as a murder weapon.

quotes.name: Blooming Marsh
quotes.flavor: A retreat to nature can inspire even the most jaded inventor.

quotes.name: Joraga Invocation
quotes.flavor:
"A single tree does not a forest make. We are stronger when we stand together."
—Numa, Joraga chieftain

quotes.name: Segovian Leviathan
quotes.flavor:
"Leviathan, too! Can you catch him with a fish-hook or run a line round his tongue?"
—Job 40:25

quotes.name: Thornglint Bridge
quotes.flavor: The path to growth is forged in balance.

quotes.name: Bloodthirsty Conqueror
quotes.flavor: "Your death will be neither quick nor painless. Agony makes blood so much sweeter."

quotes.name: Painful Quandary
quotes.flavor: In Mishra's desperation to destroy his brother, he allowed Gix to destroy him instead.

quotes.name: Sylvan Scrying
quotes.flavor:
"As long as there is a single shred of life, there is hope."
—Nissa Revane

quotes.name: Mystic Monastery
quotes.flavor: When asked how many paths reach enlightenment, the monk kicked a heap of sand. "Count," he smiled, "and then find more grains."

quotes.name: Merfolk Looter
quotes.flavor: Merfolk don't always know what they're looking for, but they're certain once they find it.

quotes.name: Sleight of Hand
quotes.flavor: "Most people believe magic is only a trick. Why change their minds?"

quotes.name: Modify Memory
quotes.set_name: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate
quotes.flavor: Percival's clothes itched and his dinner was unpleasantly wriggly, but the kobold looked like he was having the time of his life.

quotes.name: Fell the Mighty
quotes.flavor:
"There we sat high up above the floods and watched the drowning of Isengard."
—Pippin

quotes.name: Gift of Strength
quotes.flavor: The Nessian Wood is never without defenders.

quotes.name: Kemba's Legion
quotes.flavor: The squabble over succession was quickly replaced by the struggle to survive.

quotes.name: Party Crasher
quotes.flavor: No rest. No mercy. No reservations.

quotes.name: Great Sable Stag
quotes.flavor: Ineffable and incorruptible.

quotes.name: Lingering Death
quotes.flavor:
"Looks bad. I don't know if he'll make it through the night."
—Cabal cleric

quotes.name: Temur Battlecrier
quotes.flavor: When called to the land's defense, all come to protect their shared home. It's why many of the Temur use "family" and "herd" interchangeably.

quotes.name: Continue?
quotes.flavor: "You've gotta give it your all because anything less won't get the job done."

quotes.name: Storm of Souls
quotes.flavor: Devotion does not end with death.

quotes.name: Scavenger Folk
quotes.flavor: String, weapons, wax or jewels—it makes no difference. Leave nothing unguarded in Scarwood.

quotes.name: Farsight Mask
quotes.flavor: It turns the adversity of the moment into the knowledge of a lifetime.

quotes.name: Stormcarved Coast
quotes.flavor: Frequent, violent storms shape the Nephalia coastline, sculpting cliffs and caves where monsters often lurk.

quotes.name: Putrefy
quotes.flavor:
"All matter, animate or not, rots when exposed to time. We merely speed up the process."
—Ezoc, Golgari rot farmer

quotes.name: Elemental Summoning
quotes.flavor:
"You've made a splash. Now show me a torrent."
—Uvilda, Prismari dean

quotes.name: Temporal Mastery
quotes.flavor: You have all the time in the world.

quotes.name: Whirlpool Rider
quotes.flavor: Where the wind meets the water, change is inevitable.

quotes.name: Spirit of Resilience
quotes.flavor:
"We've all been broken and had to put ourselves back together with the pieces that were left."
—Kequia Akosa

quotes.name: Saproling Migration
quotes.flavor: Thallids herd saprolings from place to place in search of detritus to feed them.

quotes.name: Reclamation Specialist
quotes.flavor:
"Knowledge lives on in the Collective as software. Components are repurposed for other drones. Not the file backup I'd prefer, but I suppose it is technically immortality."
—The Doctor

quotes.name: Gnarlwood Dryad
quotes.flavor: As Emrakul's influence radiated across Innistrad, evacuation from Kessig's remote villages became increasingly difficult.

quotes.name: Bloodtracker
quotes.flavor: "Flee all you like. The further you run the more firmly I feel your heartbeat."

quotes.name: Mayhem Devil
quotes.flavor: Despite their stake in the city's survival, Rakdos cultists are loath to pass up any opportunity to sow chaos.

quotes.name: Raging Regisaur
quotes.flavor: Its breath is a gale. Its roar is a volcano. Its anger tears soul from flesh.

quotes.name: Northern Paladin
quotes.flavor:
"Look to the north; there you will find aid and comfort."
—The Book of Tal

quotes.name: Ragnarok, Divine Deliverance
quotes.flavor: When prayers turn to promises, not even fate can stand in their way.

quotes.name: Colossapede
quotes.flavor:
"If it is bigger, you must be faster. If it is stronger, you must be sharper. Anything less, and you will never seize a place in our God-Pharaoh's perfect afterlife."
—Rhonas, god of strength

quotes.name: Crucible of Fire
quotes.flavor:
"The dragon is a perfect marriage of power and the will to use it."
—Sarkhan Vol

quotes.name: Shivan Dragon
quotes.flavor:
"It's just playing with us, Marsden."
—Dafynne the Radiant, last words

quotes.name: Puncturing Light
quotes.flavor: "If you refuse to see the light, then you will feel it."

quotes.name: Rogue Kavu
quotes.flavor: "I know how this one feels," said Urza. "It's not like others of its kind and has been shunned for its differences."

quotes.name: Neglected Manor
quotes.flavor: They say every family who resided there met a grisly end, and once in a while you'll hear their screams echoing through the moldering halls.

quotes.name: Reyav, Master Smith
quotes.flavor: "There's always room for improvement."

quotes.name: Professor Zei, Anthropologist
quotes.flavor: "I'm not leaving. I can't. I've spent too long trying to find this place. There's not another collection of knowledge like this on earth."

quotes.name: Vedalken Dismisser
quotes.flavor:
"I crept up on him, quiet as a guttermouse. And then suddenly I found myself facedown in a latrine pit behind Tin Street Market."
—Sirislav, Dimir spy

quotes.name: Avenging Huntbonder
quotes.flavor: "I teach the cubs how to kill the two-legs quickly, and why it's best for the pride."

quotes.name: Pest Summoning
quotes.flavor:
"Step 1: Put the pests in mud.
"Step 2: Wait."
—*Gyome's Guide to Pest Breeding*

quotes.name: Wretched Throng
quotes.flavor:
"Oh no. Oh no. Oh no. Oh no, again!"
—Beltstad, cathar recruit, last words

quotes.name: Lodestone Myr
quotes.flavor: When necessary, myr can override and control any artificial object, as can their creator.

quotes.name: Open the Graves
quotes.flavor: It was a night like any other. It would soon become a night no one would ever forget.

quotes.name: Harsh Mentor
quotes.flavor: "Fight through it."

quotes.name: Planar Birth
quotes.flavor:
"From womb of nothingness sprang this place of beauty, purity, and hope realized."
—*Song of All*, canto 3

quotes.name: Ryusei, the Falling Star
quotes.set_name: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate
quotes.flavor: The course of the falling star always ends in ruin.

quotes.name: Tome Scour
quotes.flavor: Genius is overrated, especially when it's someone else's.

quotes.name: Technomancer
quotes.flavor:
"Witchcraft or technology, it is blasphemous, and it must be stopped."
—Inquisitor Greyfax

quotes.name: Rotting Regisaur
quotes.flavor:
"Now, *that's* a zombie!"
—Modriss of Zargoth Fen

quotes.name: Hearts on Fire
quotes.flavor:
"With you by my side, I am unstoppable."
—Halana, to Alena

quotes.name: Lost Legacy
quotes.flavor:
"That name shall not be spoken."
—Baral, Chief of Compliance

quotes.name: Chief of the Foundry
quotes.flavor: The foundries of Kaladesh run like clockwork under the supervision of their formidable overseers.

quotes.name: Reinterpret
quotes.flavor:
"With just a little added flair, your work could be truly spectacular. Let me show you."
—Nassari, Prismari dean

quotes.name: Sol Ring
quotes.set_name: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate
quotes.flavor: Lost to time is the artificer's art of trapping light from a distant star in a ring of purest gold.

quotes.name: Slagstorm
quotes.flavor:
"As long as we have the will to fight, we are never without weapons."
—Koth of the Hammer

quotes.name: Mesmeric Sliver
quotes.flavor:
"Wait, where am I? Who am I? And what are you?"
—Skyshroud secretkeeper, last words

quotes.name: Acidic Slime
quotes.flavor:
"He's more mutagen than mutant!"
—Donatello

quotes.name: Gaea's Anthem
quotes.flavor:
"To those who can hear it, Gaea's battle song brings power as swift as sunlight and as enduring as the deep roots of the forest."
—Gamelen, Citanul elder

quotes.name: Treeshaker Chimera
quotes.flavor: The wisdom of the past is written on the bones of ancients.

quotes.name: Centaur's Herald
quotes.flavor: The farther they go from Vitu-Ghazi, the less willing the crowd is to part for them.

quotes.name: Jeering Homunculus
quotes.flavor: Mklthd had always hated crowds . . . and they had always hated him.

quotes.name: Shimmerdrift Vale
quotes.flavor: Reflections from the wind-sculpted snow gleam with every color of the rainbow.

quotes.name: Kindled Heroism
quotes.flavor: Even in the grip of Hylda's unnatural cold, something in Kellan felt bright as spring, something that poured into the empty hilts he'd been given by Talion and formed thorn-sharp blades of light.

quotes.name: Skaab Goliath
quotes.flavor: Three heads are better than one.

quotes.name: Selfless Spirit
quotes.flavor: "There is always more to give."

quotes.name: Roast
quotes.flavor:
"Intruders in the lands of Atarka have but two choices: be consumed by fire, or be consumed by maw."
—Ulnok, Atarka shaman

quotes.name: Boon of Boseiju
quotes.flavor: She closed her eyes and remembered the smell of the leaves of Jukai Forest. When she opened them, the buildings of Towashi had grown small.

quotes.name: Chill of the Grave
quotes.flavor: Frozen is frozen, whether it's with cold, terror, or both.

quotes.name: Arcane Denial
quotes.flavor: "Spell request not approved. Try again later."

quotes.name: Steward of Valeron
quotes.flavor: Knight-stewards guard the Sun-Dappled Court, a grove of immense, sculptured olive trees that represent Valeron's twelve noble families.

quotes.name: Dawning Angel
quotes.flavor:
"As the sun rose behind the Bone Spire, an angel appeared over the charnel fields, bringing a surge of new hope."
—Krinnea, *Siege of the Bone Spire*

quotes.name: Seaside Citadel
quotes.flavor:
"I lived in the city of Bevelle until ten years ago. It's the biggest city in Spira! The main temple of Yevon is there."
—Yuna

quotes.name: Exemplar of Strength
quotes.flavor: "No one is born worthy."

quotes.name: Flickerwisp
quotes.flavor: Its wings disturb more than air.

quotes.name: Puppet Strings
quotes.flavor: "Have no illusions," Volrath warned Greven, "about free will."

quotes.name: Oppression
quotes.flavor:
"Defeating an enemy is not nearly as satisfying as watching one suffer."
—The Western Paladin

quotes.name: Enduring Victory
quotes.flavor:
"My dragonlord is immortal. Most dragons are not."
—Kadri, Dromoka warrior

quotes.name: Skittering Skirge
quotes.flavor: The imps' warbling cries echo through Phyrexia's towers like those of mourning doves in a cathedral.

quotes.name: Kaervek the Merciless
quotes.flavor:
"Rats and jackals feast in his swath, but even they will not walk with him."
—Mangara

quotes.name: Molecular Modifier
quotes.flavor: "Let's show those bugs our own style of splicin'."

quotes.name: Adarkar Wastes
quotes.flavor: Left barren by the Brothers' War, it stands as a stark reminder of Dominaria's likely fate should the Coalition fail.

quotes.name: Bonders' Enclave
quotes.flavor: There is a sanctuary that reveals itself only to those graced by the *eludha*—the mystical connection between bonder and monster.

quotes.name: Genji Glove
quotes.flavor: "I must say, I quite enjoy these tussles."

quotes.name: Sandstorm Charger
quotes.flavor:
"May our foes choke upon its horns!"
—Urdnan, Dromoka warrior

quotes.name: Power Fist
quotes.flavor: A fist fight will leave a bruise. A power fist fight will leave a crater.

quotes.name: Barrin, Tolarian Archmage
quotes.flavor: "There is no age at which you stop learning."

quotes.name: Universal Solvent
quotes.flavor:
"A few drops of this, and the trickiest problems simply melt away."
—Thamaz, Weldfast inventor

quotes.name: Dictate of Kruphix
quotes.flavor: "Knowledge is cruel. It will break your heart and test your allegiances. Are you certain you want this curse?"

quotes.name: Molten-Core Maestro
quotes.flavor: "My media? Fury and flame."

quotes.name: Spikeshot Goblin
quotes.flavor: The path of a goblin shaman is a journey through a thousand ways of hurting people.

quotes.name: Fireblast
quotes.flavor: Embermages aren't well known for their diplomatic skills.

quotes.name: Flight of Equenauts
quotes.flavor: "Yes, there's competition between our equenauts and the Boros skyjeks. At least they think it's a competition."

quotes.name: Maro
quotes.flavor: No two see the same Maro.

quotes.name: Zada's Commando
quotes.flavor:
"There's a word for someone who brings too much gear to battle: 'survivor.'"
—Zada of Slab Haven

quotes.name: Kulrath Zealot
quotes.flavor: The Path of Flame brought him power at the terrible cost of his own identity.

quotes.name: Advantageous Proclamation
quotes.flavor: "The beneficent council deems you worthy of favor. They hope this doesn't provoke envy from your peers."

quotes.name: Brilliant Restoration
quotes.flavor:
"We have done our best to heal this land together, but now I must entrust the future to my sister. She will carry our dreams onward into the sunrise."
—Michiko Konda's journal

quotes.name: Beetleform Mage
quotes.flavor:
"When the Simic say to take command of your life, we don't mean just your career."
—Vorel of the Hull Clade

quotes.name: Network Disruptor
quotes.flavor: "Just as I suspected. They thought they'd hidden the terminal, so they got lazy with the encryption."

quotes.name: Glowspore Shaman
quotes.flavor: From death she grows living grandeur.

quotes.name: Giant Strength
quotes.flavor:
"O! it is excellent / To have a giant's strength, but it is tyrannous / To use it like a giant."
—William Shakespeare,
*Measure for Measure*

quotes.name: Tymora's Invoker
quotes.set_name: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate
quotes.flavor: "May Lady Luck smile upon you some other day, pal."

quotes.name: Selesnya Guildgate
quotes.flavor: Enter and rejoice! The Conclave stands united, open to one and all.

quotes.name: Shady Traveler // Stalking Predator
quotes.flavor: The stranger spoke to no one, and the townspeople gladly returned the favor.

quotes.name: Ruinous Minotaur
quotes.flavor: Not every intelligent being is interested in treasure and lost knowledge . . . or even the basics of speech.

quotes.name: Gush
quotes.flavor: Don't trust your secrets to the sea.

quotes.name: Righteousness
quotes.flavor: Sometimes the greatest strength is the strength of conviction.

quotes.name: Bathe in Light
quotes.flavor: "Truth shines even in darkness. Those who march on the side of truth walk always in righteous light."

quotes.name: Pangosaur
quotes.flavor: Only Rushwood is vast enough to swallow this creature whole.

quotes.name: Chandra's Spitfire
quotes.flavor: "I've lit most everything on fire—trees, rocks, even the water. Now it's time to burn the clouds."

quotes.name: Carrion Crow
quotes.flavor: When carrion feeds on carrion, dark days approach.

quotes.name: Blazing Archon
quotes.flavor:
"Through the haze of battle I saw the glint of sun on golden mane, the sheen of glory clad in mail, and I dropped my sword and wept at the idiocy of war."
—Dravin, Gruul deserter

quotes.name: Razorgrass Ambush // Razorgrass Field
quotes.flavor: Leonin hide their dwellings within the Razor Fields, making approach deadly without knowledge of their secret paths.

quotes.name: Boros Signet
quotes.flavor:
"Have you ever held a Boros signet? There's a weight to it that belies its size—a weight of strength and of pride."
—Agrus Kos

quotes.name: Chaos Warp
quotes.flavor: The importance of using updated Pinnacle codebooks is a lesson learned only once.

quotes.name: Endless Atlas
quotes.flavor: Guarded by cartographers, disdained by warlords, coveted by adventurers.

quotes.name: Restart Sequence
quotes.flavor: In the Animus, death is only a temporary setback.

quotes.name: Skullclamp
quotes.flavor: The mind is a beautiful bounty encased in an annoying bone container.

quotes.name: Panther Habit
quotes.flavor: No mere costume, the mantle of the Panther is not a prize to be won. It is a legacy to be earned.

quotes.name: Veil of Assimilation
quotes.flavor:
"Hear only harmony. See only glory. Speak only truth."
—Atraxa

quotes.name: Annihilate
quotes.flavor:
"Whatever Yawgmoth marks, dies. There is no escape."
—Tsabo Tavoc, Phyrexian general

quotes.name: Explore
quotes.flavor: An explorer's reward is a view of tomorrow's possibilities.

quotes.name: Fear
quotes.flavor:
"The horror! The horror!"
—Joseph Conrad, *Heart of Darkness*

quotes.name: Lord of the Pit
quotes.set_name: Duel Decks Anthology: Divine vs. Demonic
quotes.flavor: "My summoning begins your debt, Planeswalker."

quotes.name: Remorseful Cleric
quotes.flavor: A lifetime of keeping up appearances is not enough to earn an eternity of rest.

quotes.name: Jorn, God of Winter // Kaldring, the Rimestaff
quotes.flavor: "Wherever snow falls, I am home."

quotes.name: Cooped Up
quotes.flavor:
"Cold iron's all you need to hold a faerie. The charms are mostly decorative."
—Eulyn, Edgewall peddler

quotes.name: Optimization Annex
quotes.flavor: The Borg had no notion of "quaint," but the simplicity of Federation technology was reassuring.

quotes.name: Rampant Growth
quotes.flavor:
"I've never *heard* growth before."
—Gowon, Femeref herder

quotes.name: Drudge Skeletons
quotes.flavor:
"The dead make good soldiers. They can't disobey orders, never surrender, and don't stop fighting when a random body part falls off."
—Nevinyrral,
*Necromancer's Handbook*

quotes.name: Overgrown Estate
quotes.flavor: The decay of Crovax's ancestral home matched the state of his soul.

quotes.name: Beast Within
quotes.flavor:
"Kill the weak so they can't drag the strong down to their level. This is true compassion."
—Benzir, archdruid of Temple Might

quotes.name: Priest of Titania
quotes.flavor: Titania rewards all who honor the forest by making them a living part of it.

quotes.name: Coiled Tinviper
quotes.flavor: The bite of the tinviper feels most like a razor drawn across the tongue.

quotes.name: Elite Archers
quotes.flavor: They fletch their arrows with the feathers of angels.

quotes.name: Hookhand Mariner // Riphook Raider
quotes.flavor: The local gossips swore Nesmith lost his hands in a fight with a werewolf.

quotes.name: Shu Soldier-Farmers
quotes.flavor: During Kongming's campaigns against the Wei, his Shu troops rotated from the battlefront to the fields every hundred days.

quotes.name: Kitchen Imp
quotes.flavor: Action: Show an imp that's a kitchen helper for Asmor, the Underworld Cook.

quotes.name: Midnight Ritual
quotes.flavor: Bury old friends deeply, lest they return bearing worms.

quotes.name: Spire of Industry
quotes.flavor: The planet itself has no value. The more efficiently the Borg can extract what they need, the better.

quotes.name: Price of Glory
quotes.flavor:
"True strength lies in action. Let the weak react to me."
—Kamahl, pit fighter

quotes.name: Haunted Ridge
quotes.flavor:
"No, no, come on, Doc. This is where you jump in with a rational explanation. I mean, ghosts don't exist, right?"
—Graham O'Brien

quotes.name: Grimclaw Bats
quotes.flavor: Even on a world of metal, there are those who thirst for blood.

quotes.name: Aarakocra Sneak
quotes.set_name: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate
quotes.flavor: "Shhh! I think I hear goblins. And I definitely smell them."

quotes.name: Tavern Ruffian // Tavern Smasher
quotes.flavor: She dispatched every challenger with a sickening snap of bone.

quotes.name: Master of Barbs
quotes.flavor: The question isn't *if* he'll make his students cry. Only when.

quotes.name: Y'shtola Rhul
quotes.flavor: "As I suspected, the aetheric disturbance here is no natural occurrence."

quotes.name: Yavimaya Dryad
quotes.flavor: The parched earth still shielded those few souls with the heart to call it home.

quotes.name: Wood Elves
quotes.set_name: Duel Decks: Nissa vs. Ob Nixilis
quotes.flavor: Through the waves of Eldrazi attacks, the Murasan jungles seemed to regrow as soon as they were destroyed.

quotes.name: Feast of Blood
quotes.flavor: Imbued in the Ancient Fang were spells far darker than any Dack Fayden would cast.

quotes.name: Iron Suitcase
quotes.flavor: Iron Man always has a spare suit on hand.

quotes.name: Spell Pierce
quotes.flavor:
"There's a hole in your plan."
—Noyan Dar, Tazeem lullmage

quotes.name: Reclaim
quotes.flavor: The wise pay as much attention to what they throw away as to what they keep.

quotes.name: Bottle Gnomes
quotes.flavor:
"I am reminded of the fable of the silver egg. Its owner cracks it open to see what jewels it holds, only to discover a simple yellow yolk."
—Karn, silver golem

quotes.name: Vanishing Verse
quotes.flavor: "Whoever summoned that thing had better confess right this moment, or the whole class will be cleaning the ink receptacles for a month!"

quotes.name: Hordeling Outburst
quotes.flavor:
"Leave no scraps, lest you attract pests."
—Mardu threat

quotes.name: Trufflesnout
quotes.flavor: Its exploits are the stuff of legends among local chefs and fuel for nightmares among the forest thallids.

quotes.name: Talisman of Conviction
quotes.flavor: Grognak. Silver Shroud. Manta Man. Mistress of Mystery. The Inspector. The heroes united together to become ... The Unstoppables.

quotes.name: Delighted Halfling
quotes.set_name: The Lord of the Rings: Tales of Middle-earth
quotes.flavor: There were toys the Hobbit-children had never seen before, all beautiful, and some obviously magical.

quotes.name: Soldier of the Pantheon
quotes.flavor: "I hear the gods' voices in my dreams each night, and I offer bloody trophies on their altars each day."

quotes.name: Crossroads Consecrator
quotes.flavor: "May the steel of your blade match the steel in your soul."

quotes.name: Elite Skirmisher
quotes.flavor: Some adopted the tactics of the leonin to combat the ferocity of the minotaurs.

quotes.name: Eroded Canyon
quotes.flavor:
"The water looks like liquid gold. Wonder how many died trying to bottle it."
—Pioneer journal of Big Ralph

quotes.name: Anafenza, Kin-Tree Spirit
quotes.flavor: The Machine Legion coveted her strength, but a spirit of sand, sun, and memory could never be *compleated*.

quotes.name: Ashroot Animist
quotes.flavor: "We will burn down the old growth of civilization and nurture what sprouts from the ashes."

quotes.name: Meddling Mage
quotes.flavor: "This violent wasteland is an indictment of its people. These cowards lack the will to oppose disorder."

quotes.name: Giant Mantis
quotes.flavor:
"I hate insects of every sort. The only mercy is that they are generally small."
—Mwani, Mtenda goatherd

quotes.name: Vision Skeins
quotes.flavor: "I could see in the other mage's eyes that he'd thought of it too. Then it became a race to exploit the knowledge first."

quotes.name: Dreadmalkin
quotes.flavor: The feline Eternal felt Liliana's command, looked at her disdainfully, flicked its paw, and scampered away across the rooftops.

quotes.name: Engine Rat
quotes.flavor: In a land of undeath, permanent pest control solutions are few and far between.

quotes.name: Merciless Executioner
quotes.flavor: Kommandos differ from usual Orks. They still want to kill you. They just want to surprise you before they do it.

quotes.name: Giant Spider
quotes.flavor: The Broken Lands are littered with the remnants of civilizations long dead and infested by terrors very much alive.

quotes.name: Castle Ardenvale
quotes.set_name: Phyrexia: All Will Be One Commander
quotes.flavor: Without Ardenvale's loyalty, the realm would greedily devour itself.

quotes.name: Tower Winder
quotes.flavor: The tower guards eventually gave up, figuring it was better at the job anyway.

quotes.name: Borderland Ranger
quotes.flavor: "There's only one route from Kessig into Stensia. Unless you come with me."

quotes.name: Choose Your Champion
quotes.flavor: "I am nothing if not fair. I've chosen my champion. Now you must choose yours."

quotes.name: Devouring Swarm
quotes.flavor: Their arrival is heralded by the deafening hum of ten thousand wings. Their departure is marked by the silence of the dead.

quotes.name: Beloved Princess
quotes.flavor: Sometimes a gentle slipper can travel where an armored boot's been denied.

quotes.name: Redress Fate
quotes.flavor: "I can't go with you into the House, but I can give you one chance to reverse your doom. Make it count."

quotes.name: Uthden Troll
quotes.flavor:
<< Tapez du poing,
Tapez du pied
Sur ma face de sagouin
Tant que vous voulez,
Demain matin, je serais sur pied. >>
- Moqueries trolls.

quotes.name: Thraben Inspector
quotes.flavor: "If you've been at this as long as I have, nothing can surprise you. That's the hope, at least."

quotes.name: Persistent Petitioners
quotes.flavor: ". . . the king's burning heart must be laid to rest at last. And furthermore . . ."

quotes.name: Glint
quotes.flavor: Rakshasa waste no opportunity to display their wealth and power, even in the midst of a sorcerous duel.

quotes.name: Mnemonic Sphere
quotes.flavor:
"Let the Imperials search our laboratories. Will they think to look for secrets in a pretty bauble?"
—Emire, director of the Saiba Futurists

quotes.name: Ajani's Pridemate
quotes.flavor: Once rejected by his pride, Ajani is now revered by countless leonin as a healer and, more importantly, a friend.

quotes.name: Serra Angel
quotes.flavor: Born with wings of light and a sword of faith, this heavenly incarnation embodies both fury and purity.

quotes.name: Dissatisfied Customer
quotes.flavor: The mirrors weren't fun for everyone.

quotes.name: Priest of Gix
quotes.flavor: "Take my mind, so that it may serve the will of Phyrexia. Take my flesh, so I may become compleat."

quotes.name: Illithid Harvester // Plant Tadpoles
quotes.flavor: "Your mind belongs to the Emperor now."

quotes.name: Stroke of Midnight
quotes.flavor:
"Who was that knight, so graceful and strong? Why did she flee before the food was gone?"
—*Tale of the Masked Maiden*

quotes.name: Howling Mine
quotes.flavor:
"The Sardian dwarves have let superstition override common sense. There's plenty of ore left in the mountain, and we mustn't let it go to waste."
—Last dispatch of Bolgon, Argivian surveyor

quotes.name: Kalastria Nightwatch
quotes.flavor:
"Kalitas may have returned to mindless servitude beneath the Eldrazi, but we say never again."
—Drana, Kalastria bloodchief

quotes.name: Yume, Chronicler of Valor
quotes.flavor: Tales of heroics fill the air between matches at Valor's Reach.

quotes.name: Harrow
quotes.flavor: The Roil redraws the world as it passes, leaving only the hedrons unchanged.

quotes.name: Leaf Arrow
quotes.flavor:
"Those who think the trees shall remain bystanders throughout this conflict shall be sorely mistaken."
—Sutina, Speaker of the Tajuru

quotes.name: Sundering Vitae
quotes.flavor: Centuries of wind, rain, and roots compressed into an instant of destruction: such is the power of Selesnya.

quotes.name: Kotori, Pilot Prodigy
quotes.flavor: "Some people test limits. I prefer to demolish them."

quotes.name: Kindred Discovery
quotes.flavor: It is in the nature of a hero to inspire others.

quotes.name: Hill Giant
quotes.flavor: Fortunately, Hill Giants have large blind spots in which a human can easily hide. Unfortunately, these blind spots are beneath the bottoms of their feet.

quotes.name: Seat of the Synod
quotes.flavor: Lumengrid, site of the Knowledge Pool, source of vedalken arcana.

quotes.name: Tolarian Winds
quotes.flavor: Afterward, Tolaria's winds were like the whispers of lost wizards, calling for life.

quotes.name: Vicious Rivalry
quotes.flavor: So intense was their hatred they didn't realize how lonely they'd become. In the end, all they had was each other, and they hated that, too.

quotes.name: Gather the Townsfolk
quotes.flavor: In the memories of those they lost lies the strength needed to defend their city.

quotes.name: Quicksilver Amulet
quotes.flavor: Those who examine the amulet too closely have been known to become part of its ornate carvings.

quotes.name: Arvad the Cursed
quotes.flavor: "I won't abandon the *Weatherlight*. My destiny is to serve at Jhoira's side. This 'illness' means I must trust my faith more and myself less."

quotes.name: Combine Chrysalis
quotes.flavor: Action: Please design a Simic device that turns smaller creatures into big flying beasts.

quotes.name: Thundering Spineback
quotes.flavor:
"It appears that nature has risen against us."
—Captain Brinely Rage

quotes.name: Zimone, Paradox Sculptor
quotes.flavor: "Extraplanar geometry isn't so hard once you get used to thinking in twelve dimensions."

quotes.name: Hungry Flames
quotes.flavor: In the hold of the *Heart of Kiran*, Chandra answered Dovin Baan's sabotage with an explosive retort.

quotes.name: Diminish
quotes.flavor: Everything seems a little less ferocious when it's running from a house cat.

quotes.name: Flaring Pain
quotes.flavor:
"I don't rub salt in wounds. I use sulfur."
—Matoc, lavamancer

quotes.name: Lost in Space
quotes.flavor: Every so often, the Edge reminds you that there's always more to discover.

quotes.name: Game Plan
quotes.flavor: Plan for victory, or prepare for defeat.

quotes.name: Dimir Spybug
quotes.flavor: Just assume every conversation is on record.

quotes.name: Bloodforged Battle-Axe
quotes.flavor: With just his trusty axe, Grognak became king.

quotes.name: Aettir and Priwen
quotes.flavor:
"The pinnacle o' perfection, forged from blood, sweat, an' tears!"
—Gerolt Blackthorne

quotes.name: Fairgrounds Trumpeter
quotes.flavor:
"What is that horrible flesh-noise?! We must silence it before it grows even louder!"
—Thxmir, Machine Legion scout

quotes.name: Watery Grave
quotes.flavor:
"Log 2.9.089: Lammuat, the cemetery moon of salvage and secrets. Could be profitable for those brave enough to plumb its recesses."
—*Maisie's Edge Chronicles*

quotes.name: Tectonic Break
quotes.flavor: Only the foolish and the rich build their houses where the land is thin and the ocean is near.

quotes.name: Tigra, Feline Fury
quotes.flavor: "Say 'Here, kitty kitty' one more time. I dare you."

quotes.name: Electrify
quotes.flavor: "Some hid from the storm. I embraced it and learned its name."

quotes.name: Shuttle Ace
quotes.flavor: Although she was a Kelpien, a prey species, she feared no predator once behind the controls.

quotes.name: Embodiment of Spring
quotes.flavor: Arel dreamed of winter's end. The next morning she followed a strange trail and found a seedling in the snow.

quotes.name: Trained Condor
quotes.flavor:
"They're smart enough to understand that war means lots of carrion."
—Griv, condor rider

quotes.name: Harsh Mentor
quotes.flavor: "Fight through it."

quotes.name: Silverfur Partisan
quotes.flavor: Silverfurs are the last remaining wolfir.

quotes.name: Watery Grave
quotes.flavor:
"I fear that as we scurry after phantoms, the Dimir pull nine puppet strings."
—Ral Zarek

quotes.name: Temp of the Damned
quotes.flavor: "Not the graveyard shift again!"

quotes.name: Poison Arrow
quotes.flavor: In ancient China, not wearing armor could be a fatal mistake. Guan Yu, Zhou Yu, Sun Ce, and other heros were struck by poison arrows.

quotes.name: Meeting of Minds
quotes.flavor:
"If something seems impossible, you probably haven't tried asking for help."
—Niambi, cleric of Dominaria

quotes.name: Calamitous Tide
quotes.flavor: Zoraline turned her attention to the shore. Helga and Ral's conversation quickly faded from her mind as she watched the gigantic wave approach.

quotes.name: Civic Stalwart
quotes.flavor: "These are your streets. Defend them! This is your neighborhood. Honor it! This is your city. Save it!"

quotes.name: Shambling Goblin
quotes.flavor:
"The Kolaghan send them at us. We kill and raise them. They fight the next wave the Kolaghan send. It's a neat little cycle."
—Asmala, Silumgar sorcerer

quotes.name: Rusted Relic
quotes.flavor:
"We consider rust a curable disease."
—Tarrin, Hammer-Tribe shaman

quotes.name: Dread Cacodemon
quotes.flavor: Those who hear its roar perish. The lucky ones only feel its fetid breath.

quotes.name: Off Balance
quotes.flavor: A heavy weapon deals plenty of damage—but it does have to hit.

quotes.name: Krark's Other Thumb
quotes.flavor: Krark was the kind of goblin who'd lose his thumb in a wager and come right back with "Double or nothing!"

quotes.name: Ayara, First of Locthwain
quotes.flavor: Mourning shifts seamlessly to celebration as she chooses her next suitor.

quotes.name: Zoetic Cavern
quotes.flavor: Nothing lives within it, yet there is life.

quotes.name: Chain Reaction
quotes.flavor:
"We train for the improbable, like lightning striking the same place twice, or striking everywhere at once."
—Nundari, Sea Gate militia captain

quotes.name: Stomp and Howl
quotes.flavor:
"Mizzium may be impervious to fire, but obviously certain other things can . . . modify its form."
—Ivos Koba, indrik handler

quotes.name: Ledger Shredder
quotes.flavor: No evidence, no crime.

quotes.name: Surprise, Nerd!
quotes.flavor: Designed by players at MagicCon Chicago 2025.

quotes.name: Spectral Sailor
quotes.flavor:
"Any ship that sails on these mean seas for long is bound to pick up a ghost or two."
—Admiral Beckett Brass

quotes.name: Black Knight
quotes.flavor: Battle doesn't need a purpose; the battle is its own purpose. You don't ask why a plague spreads or a field burns. Don't ask why I fight.

quotes.name: Jungle Wurm
quotes.flavor: Broad as a baobab—and about as smart.

quotes.name: Elvish Ranger
quotes.flavor: It's up to you if you enter their woods—and up to them if you leave.

quotes.name: Wilt in the Heat
quotes.flavor: "'It'll be fun,' they said. 'The Fields are full of dead things,' they said."

quotes.name: Fear of Exposure
quotes.flavor: A mouth like that can never keep secrets.

quotes.name: Garth One-Eye
quotes.flavor: Mood: A powerful, quirky, curious man.

quotes.name: Grim Poppet
quotes.flavor: Beware a scarecrow bearing gifts—especially sloshing vessels of acid.

quotes.name: Quicksmith Spy
quotes.flavor: "Let's just broaden its surveillance lens."

quotes.name: Plaguecrafter
quotes.flavor: "My power is generosity, in a way. I give my survivors an appreciation for their lives."

quotes.name: Simic Guildgate
quotes.flavor: Simic biomancers don't concern themselves with guarding a gate. Their ever-present creations are enough to ward off trespassers.

quotes.name: Impatience
quotes.flavor: Ask a Keldon to hold his temper and you'll be left holding your guts.

quotes.name: Galadriel of Lothlórien
quotes.set_name: The Lord of the Rings: Tales of Middle-earth
quotes.flavor: "I pass the test. I will diminish, and go into the West, and remain Galadriel."

quotes.name: Jump Scare
quotes.flavor: "Boo!"

quotes.name: Hill Giant
quotes.flavor: Fortunately, Hill Giants have large blind spots in which a human can easily hide. Unfortunately, these blind spots are beneath the bottoms of their feet.

quotes.name: Feast or Famine
quotes.flavor:
"We are not yet free of Lim-Dûl's terrors."
—Halvor Arensson, Kjeldoran priest

quotes.name: Ward Sliver
quotes.flavor: The first wave of slivers perished from the Riptide wizards' magic. The second wave shrugged off their spells like water.

quotes.name: The Eighth Doctor
quotes.flavor: "Physician, heal thyself."

quotes.name: Brotherhood Ambushers
quotes.flavor: The ones you can see are just a distraction. There are many others, hidden in the shadows, waiting for the perfect moment to strike unseen.

quotes.name: Summon: G.F. Ifrit
quotes.flavor: "Hm! Not bad for a human."

quotes.name: Tranquil Cove
quotes.flavor: In the South, the realm of Gondor long endured, and for a while its splendor grew, its people building high towers and havens for many ships.

quotes.name: Piston-Fist Cyclops
quotes.flavor: Its hyperpneumatics can punch through a wall and the spy on the other side.

quotes.name: Eliminate
quotes.flavor:
「人を消すのにほとんどエネルギーはいらない。稀で宇宙がその存在を全く気にしてないかのようにな。」
——エクスタス・ナー

quotes.name: Omni-Cheese Pizza
quotes.flavor:
"And just a sprig of parsley for color . . ."
—Michelangelo

quotes.name: Training Regimen
quotes.flavor:
"Rerack your weights, heroes. Gym staff could actually die trying to do it."
—Avengers training room note

quotes.name: Copperhorn Scout
quotes.flavor: Fangren spur may sound louder, but Viridian resurgents claim that the horn of the vorrac creates a truer, more inspiring note.

quotes.name: Frontier Bivouac
quotes.flavor:
"The most powerful dreams visit those who shelter in a dragon's skull."
—Chianul, Who Whispers Twice

quotes.name: Bant Panorama
quotes.flavor: Bant's hearts are as pure as its air and as bright as its skies.

quotes.name: Narset, Jeskai Waymaster
quotes.flavor: With no dragonlord to hold her back, she was free to learn every secret Ugin left behind.

quotes.name: Foreboding Ruins
quotes.flavor:
"I love old things. They make me feel sad."
—Sally Sparrow

quotes.name: Weight of the Underworld
quotes.flavor: Proud Alkmenos, who would not bow to Erebos in death, is now bowed by his own hubris for all eternity.

quotes.name: Lotus Petal
quotes.flavor: Each of these intricate mechanical petals stores enough power to supply all of Ghirapur, if only for a fleeting moment.

quotes.name: Urborg, Tomb of Yawgmoth
quotes.flavor:
"Yawgmoth's corpse is a wound in the universe. His foul blood seeps out, infecting the land with his final curse."
—Lord Windgrace

quotes.name: Grab the Prize
quotes.flavor: Unfortunately, the keyhole turned out to be located in an even larger, scarier clown mouth.

quotes.name: Drudge Skeletons
quotes.flavor:
"The dead make good soldiers. They can't disobey orders, they never surrender, and they don't stop fighting when a random body part falls off."
—Nevinyrral,
*Necromancer's Handbook*

quotes.name: Mortivore
quotes.flavor: The light sigh of its breath whistles through its bones.

quotes.name: Runed Servitor
quotes.flavor: Scholars had puzzled for centuries over the ruins at Tal Terig. Its secrets had always lived within one rune-carved head.

quotes.name: Bogstomper
quotes.flavor:
"They are gentle herbivores, despite their size. Approach cautiously, and hum a tune to let them know you mean no harm."
—Vivien Reid

quotes.name: Huatli's Spurring
quotes.flavor: "Run like the wind, fierce one. The hunt has begun."

quotes.name: Teferi's Time Twist
quotes.flavor: "The safest place for you is not now."

quotes.name: Avabruck Caretaker // Hollowhenge Huntmaster
quotes.flavor: "PLEASE DO NOT BE ALARMED. WE TIP VERY WELL."

quotes.name: Slave of Bolas
quotes.flavor: Nicol Bolas doesn't distinguish between servants and victims.

quotes.name: Civilized Scholar // Homicidal Brute
quotes.flavor: For a moment his basest desires run free, unshackled by reason or conscience.

quotes.name: Time Reversal
quotes.flavor:
"Optimists see the world as they wish it to be. Pessimists see the world as it is. Must these roles be mutually exclusive?"
—Evo Ragus

quotes.name: Severed Strands
quotes.flavor: "I've seen Ravnica's fate. Believe me, I'm doing you a favor."

quotes.name: Wibbly-wobbly, Timey-wimey
quotes.flavor: "People assume time is a strict progression of cause to effect, but actually, from a non-linear, non-subjective viewpoint, it's more like a big ball of wibbly-wobbly, timey-wimey stuff."

quotes.name: Putrefy
quotes.flavor: Even in death, a glowing one can emit a lethal amount of radiation. The fungus doesn't seem to mind though.

quotes.name: Jedit Ojanen of Efrava
quotes.flavor: The cat warriors recognized this Jedit's face, but not his fierce loyalty to Efrava.

quotes.name: Fierce Invocation
quotes.flavor: Anger can empower those who embrace it.

quotes.name: Murk Dwellers
quotes.flavor: When Raganorn unsealed the catacombs, he found more than the dead and their treasures.

quotes.name: Trudge Garden
quotes.flavor:
"Sure, trudges smell like soggy death, but the mushrooms on their backs are the tastiest delicacy in Sedgemoor!"
—Gyome, Witherbloom chef

quotes.name: Dismiss
quotes.flavor:
"There is nothing you can do that I cannot simply deny."
—Ertai, wizard adept

quotes.name: Breath of Fire
quotes.flavor: Fire leads to more fire.

quotes.name: Shatter
quotes.flavor: The ogre's mind snapped. The bow was next. The archer followed quickly after.

quotes.name: Spellskite
quotes.flavor:
"Let's show Vorinclex that progress doesn't always need teeth or claws."
—Malcator, Executor of Synthesis

quotes.name: Roon of the Hidden Realm
quotes.flavor: "Time and space are just new battlefields to be mastered."

quotes.name: Plummet
quotes.flavor: An arrow from Nylea's bow never fails to find its mark.

quotes.name: Ascend from Avernus
quotes.flavor: Smoke clogged the streets and rubble littered the ground, but sunlight shining on the long-lost towers of Elturel was still a beautiful sight.

quotes.name: Searing Wind
quotes.flavor:
"The first wind of ascension is Forger, burning away impurity."
—*Keld Triumphant*

quotes.name: Jandor's Saddlebags
quotes.flavor:
Your heart's desire is found within.
—Saddlebag inscription

quotes.name: Elvish Champion
quotes.flavor:
"For what are leaves but countless blades
To fight a countless foe on high."
—Skyshroud hymn

quotes.name: Soul Shepherd
quotes.flavor:
"The sidar who raised me had a saying: 'The first step into death is the hardest.'"
—Gerrard of the *Weatherlight*

quotes.name: Mistmeadow Witch
quotes.flavor: Olka collected the evening mist for years, studying its secrets. Once she learned its essence, she could vanish with a thought.

quotes.name: Ohran Frostfang
quotes.flavor: Even the smallest drop of its deadly venom will subtract decades from your lifespan.

quotes.name: Aku Djinn
quotes.flavor:
"Your arrogance amazes me, Kaervek. Did you not know the price you would pay?"
—Mangara

quotes.name: Harmonic Sliver
quotes.flavor:
"Since the last sliver arrived, even our mightiest relics splinter into shards as soon as we bring them against the hive."
—Llanach, Skyshroud ranger

quotes.name: Rogue's Passage
quotes.flavor: The Railroad is an organization dedicated to freeing synths from the influence of the Institute. Their HQ is a secret location found by following the Freedom Trail.

quotes.name: Elvish Scrapper
quotes.flavor: "The stories tell of a distant time when machines overran the forests, destroying everything that lived. That time will not come again."

quotes.name: Vengeance
quotes.flavor: Bitter as wormwood, sweet as mulled wine.

quotes.name: Destructor Dragon
quotes.flavor: After countless attacks on the Salt Road where it passes through the frozen tundra, the Abzan began to refer to the area as Atarka territory rather than Temur lands.

quotes.name: Commander's Sphere
quotes.flavor: It harmonizes with the essence of its master.

quotes.name: Munda's Vanguard
quotes.flavor: "Do not let yourselves fall now. Zendikar is depending on us—on you!"

quotes.name: Condescend
quotes.flavor: "Shame we'll never see what all the fuss was about."

quotes.name: Skirsdag High Priest
quotes.flavor: "Thraben's pleas fall on deaf ears. Ours do not."

quotes.name: Auron's Inspiration
quotes.flavor:
"Now is the time to choose! Now is the time to shape your stories! Your fate is in your hands!"
—Auron

quotes.name: Civilized Scholar // Homicidal Brute
quotes.flavor: "Me, angry? Of course not. Thanks to my research, I'm above such petty emotions now."

quotes.name: Circuits Act
quotes.flavor: Another day, another item Pietra has to add to the "do not juggle" database.

quotes.name: Infestation Expert // Infested Werewolf
quotes.flavor: . . . "What's bugging you?"

quotes.name: Dimir Doppelganger
quotes.flavor: "Fear not. Your life will not go unlived."

quotes.name: Aetherblade Agent // Gitaxian Mindstinger
quotes.flavor: The Consulate of Kaladesh had always valued his particular talent for extracting information . . .

quotes.name: Yahenni, Undying Partisan
quotes.flavor: "The time for subtlety is over, darling."

quotes.name: Suntail Hawk
quotes.flavor: Its eye the glaring sun, its cry the keening wind.

quotes.name: Wall of Air
quotes.flavor:
"Let the air itself protect you, for it is everywhere."
—Master wizard

quotes.name: Paper Tiger
quotes.flavor: The tiger is always quick to fold.

quotes.name: Fact or Fiction
quotes.flavor: "Slimefoot, I know I said I wanted to grow our repository of knowledge, but this isn't what I had in mind."

quotes.name: Shanodin Dryads
quotes.flavor: Moving without sound, swift figures pass through branches and undergrowth completely unhindered. One with the trees around them, the Dryads of Shanodin Forest are seen only when they wish to be.

quotes.name: Sphinx's Tutelage
quotes.flavor: "You've never considered the implications of dealing with another telepath, Jace."

quotes.name: Rhox
quotes.flavor: It's as solid as the club in its hand—and about as subtle.

quotes.name: Dutiful Servants
quotes.flavor: Buildings crumbled and monuments fell. The river bled and the sky wept tears of fire. All the while, servants silently continued their work, oblivious to it all.

quotes.name: Mogg Maniac
quotes.flavor: Stand clear if he gets an itch.

quotes.name: General's Enforcer
quotes.flavor: More stubborn than Drannith's walls.

quotes.name: Control Magic
quotes.flavor:
"Do as I think, not as I do."
—Jace Beleren

quotes.name: Storm Crow
quotes.flavor: Storm crow descending, winter unending. Storm crow departing, summer is starting.

quotes.name: Goblin Bushwhacker
quotes.flavor: If you need a job done quick and extra stabby, call "McChoppy."

quotes.name: Shivan Dragon
quotes.flavor: The undisputed master of the mountains of Shiv.

quotes.name: Oxidda Daredevil
quotes.flavor: His goggles spattered with grime and his mouth full of bugs, he tossed the engines another priceless relic.

quotes.name: Blur of Blades
quotes.flavor: Samut battled her way through the hordes, shouting the names of those who'd died in her crop and those she hoped yet to save.

quotes.name: Vault of Whispers
quotes.flavor:
"Koilos, the Thran prison-city, built to house their outcasts and dissidents. It was here that Phyrexia's influence first festered."
—*Fall of the Thran*

quotes.name: Anaba Shaman
quotes.flavor:
"The Shamans? Ha! They are mere craven cows not capable of true magic."
—Irini Sengir

quotes.name: Coma Veil
quotes.flavor: Etherium does not know sleep. Only magic can teach it the resting state of cold steel.

quotes.name: Sleight of Hand
quotes.flavor:
"Confounding an enemy can be as effective as disarming them."
—*The Trickster's Guide to Staying Alive*

quotes.name: Avatar of the Resolute
quotes.flavor: It exemplifies the ideals of the Dromoka: strength, unity, and honor.

quotes.name: Base Camp
quotes.flavor: A new dawn, a new adventure.

quotes.name: Throne of the God-Pharaoh
quotes.flavor: Crafted from the poisoned bones of wyverns by Snake Mountain's first inhabitants.

quotes.name: Tuktuk Grunts
quotes.flavor: Goblins are more aggressive with a crowd to cheer them on.

quotes.name: Meditate
quotes.flavor:
"Part of me believes that Barrin taught me meditation simply to shut me up."
—Ertai, wizard adept

quotes.name: Raise the Past
quotes.flavor: Conyan the Great carefully selected his last words as he lay bleeding on the battlefield. Moments later, he snapped awake in a body of stone, with a startled, curious face peering at him.

quotes.name: Lightning Rift
quotes.flavor: Options will cost you, but a lack of them will cost you even more.

quotes.name: Eddie Brock // Venom, Lethal Protector
quotes.flavor: "I've got the nose for the story. He's got the hunger for the kill. Together..."

quotes.name: Sleight of Hand
quotes.flavor: The farmer was amazed to see the penny vanish into thin air, but the goose knew he'd just slipped it to the faerie.

quotes.name: Costly Plunder
quotes.flavor: No lock of iron is a match for Vraska's will of stone.

quotes.name: Raiders' Spoils
quotes.flavor:
"To conquer is to eat."
—Edicts of Ilagra

quotes.name: Component Collector
quotes.flavor: "Keep master busy with new bits or else maybe she wonders if I'm made of bits too."

quotes.name: Elfsworn Giant
quotes.flavor: He upheld his vow to the elves by watching their woods and blazing their trails.

quotes.name: Serpent Warrior
quotes.flavor: A hiss before dying.

quotes.name: Walk the Plank
quotes.flavor: When Captain Thorn adds a new ship to his fleet, he gives the crew a simple choice: follow me, or fall in the sea.

quotes.name: Assembled Alphas
quotes.flavor: There is always a toll to pay for passage.

quotes.name: Sunhome Stalwart
quotes.flavor: "Before I let you wield one of these, let's see you dodge one!"

quotes.name: Descend upon the Sinful
quotes.flavor: Above the cries, a phrase rang out: "You will all be saved."

quotes.name: Harbinger of Night
quotes.flavor:
Embrace the Harbinger
—Suq'Ata expression meaning "abandon hope"

quotes.name: Hedron Archive
quotes.set_name: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate
quotes.flavor:
"You've begun to understand the hedrons' true purpose," said Ugin. "The Eldrazi can be imprisoned."
"And how did that work out last time?" asked Jace.

quotes.name: Decimate
quotes.flavor: Anarchy comes in many forms: social, individual, Gruul . . .

quotes.name: Urza's Tower
quotes.flavor: Urza always put Tocasia's lessons on resource-gathering to effective use.

quotes.name: Divine Retribution
quotes.flavor:
"To the undiscerning eye, justice and vengeance can look the same."
—Rashida Scalebane

quotes.name: Stolen Vitality
quotes.flavor: "There's nothing like a good meal to really lift the spirit."

quotes.name: Duress
quotes.flavor: "Change your mind, or I'll change it for you."

quotes.name: Ornithopter
quotes.flavor: Many scholars believe that these creatures were the result of Urza's first attempt at mechanical life, perhaps created in his early days as an apprentice to Tocasia.

quotes.name: Helping Hand
quotes.flavor:
「優しさとは一種の争いであり、決して失ってはいけないものである。」
――「戦癒しの論文」

quotes.name: Knights of Dol Amroth
quotes.set_name: The Lord of the Rings: Tales of Middle-earth
quotes.flavor: And so the companies came and were hailed and cheered and passed through the Gate.

quotes.name: Rest in Peace
quotes.flavor: "I will keep watch."

quotes.name: Basandra, Battle Seraph
quotes.flavor: "Why listen to the mumblings of wizards when the lash speaks true?"

quotes.name: Eldrazi Repurposer
quotes.flavor:
"I almost admire their ability to avoid waste. Almost."
—General Tazri, allied commander

quotes.name: Befoul
quotes.flavor: The bog's touch means death to all but the darkest of hearts.

quotes.name: Field Surgeon
quotes.flavor: Commanders order soldiers to attack. Field surgeons order them to heal. Both are obeyed without question.

quotes.name: Spectral Sliver
quotes.flavor:
"Sure, I've seen agents of the Cabal here and there. Well, not here, and certainly not in any of the sliver labs. Oh dear, I've said too much."
—Apprentice researcher

quotes.name: Ominous Sphinx
quotes.flavor: The sphinxes began to speak only after the Second Sun aligned. They whispered dire warnings, though no one listened.

quotes.name: Krotiq Nestguard
quotes.flavor: The bushwhacker's machete glanced off the root with a sickening crack. Slowly, the entire undergrowth turned to face him.

quotes.name: Lightning Blast
quotes.flavor:
"I'll climb down soon. Don't worry, it's just a thundersto—"
—Former elvish scout

quotes.name: Northern Paladin
quotes.flavor:
"Look to the north; there you will find aid and comfort."
—*The Book of Tal*

quotes.name: Harrier Strix
quotes.flavor: It can see in both darkness and daylight, but it hunts best when thunder growls in the sky.

quotes.name: Farbog Revenant
quotes.flavor: Spiteful geists rise from the muck of the Farbogs, eager to lure travelers to their doom.

quotes.name: Darksteel Mutation
quotes.flavor:
"Dissent will become perfection."
—Elesh Norn

quotes.name: Consuming Bonfire
quotes.flavor:
"The elves use treefolk to drive us away. It is time to remove their tools."
—Vessifrus, flamekin demagogue

quotes.name: Phyrexian Reclamation
quotes.flavor:
"I don't care what it takes, put a lid on this."
—Mr. Sullivan, Play Pals CEO

quotes.name: Mold Adder
quotes.flavor: The more you struggle against its coils, the tighter they get.

quotes.name: Ranger of Eos
quotes.flavor: At his side, humble beasts become weapons more deadly than sharpened steel.

quotes.name: Icatian Infantry
quotes.flavor:
"Valiant Icatia was the last of the Sarpadian empires to fall. Its faithful soldiers defended their cities to the very end."
—*Sarpadian Empires, vol. VI*

quotes.name: Wall of Bone
quotes.flavor: The Wall of Bone is said to be an aspect of the Great Wall in Hel, where the bones of all sinners wait for Ragnarok, when Hela will call them forth for the final battle.

quotes.name: Stalking Vengeance
quotes.flavor: Something roams the killing places, sniffing the guilt of the slayers, stalking them on iron paws.

quotes.name: Dense Foliage
quotes.flavor:
"Big plants not only good for hidin', but full o' tasty bugs, too."
—Squee, goblin cabin hand

quotes.name: Cultivate
quotes.flavor: All seeds share a common bond, calling to each other across infinity.

quotes.name: Network Disruptor
quotes.flavor: "Just as I suspected. They thought they'd hidden the terminal, so they got lazy with the encryption."

quotes.name: Jukai Preserver
quotes.flavor: "The kami grant you this boon, not I."

quotes.name: Explore
quotes.flavor: "Do not be afraid!" said Gandalf. "For you are not going like Frodo to Mordor, but to Minas Tirith, and there you will be as safe as you can be anywhere in these days."

quotes.name: Thought Distortion
quotes.flavor:
"The skull is rigid, but the mind is so deliciously supple."
—Eromena the Mind Render

quotes.name: Ghostly Flicker
quotes.flavor: Sometimes it's useful to take a break from existence.

quotes.name: Celestial Purge
quotes.flavor:
"They say only the good die young. Obviously, you are one of the exceptions."
—Delrobah, cleric of Ivora Gate

quotes.name: Brassclaw Orcs
quotes.flavor:
"Modern Sarpadia's swarming with thrulls. It's a testament to the orcs that they've survived there so long."
—Elbieta, Argivian scholar

quotes.name: Azorius Justiciar
quotes.flavor: "Your potential to commit a crime warrants further investigation."

quotes.name: Thunderfoot Baloth
quotes.flavor: If you hear it, it's too late.

quotes.name: Wicked Reward
quotes.flavor:
"The blood on my hands is merely proof of my ambition."
—Kaervek

quotes.name: Woodwraith Corrupter
quotes.flavor:
"Its darkened sap penetrates natural fibers and spreads its own genes. Emulation experiments are underway."
—Simic research notes

quotes.name: Neriv, Heart of the Storm
quotes.flavor: Scales streaked with lightning, trailing thunder in his wake, Neriv is the living banner around which the Mardu rally.

quotes.name: Yawgmoth's Edict
quotes.flavor:
"Phyrexia's purity permits no other."
—Xantcha, Phyrexian outcast

quotes.name: Aggressive Mammoth
quotes.flavor:
"Approach from behind. That way, if it does charge, at least you aren't in front of it."
—Vivien Reid

quotes.name: Go for Blood
quotes.flavor: Lukka's bond provided not only friendship, but also the most powerful weapon in his arsenal.

quotes.name: Syncopate
quotes.flavor: "Your eyes, they burn with resolve . . . beautiful."
